scope: Sequentially inspect up to 48 post-row-30 candidates and add up to 12 rows only when the real live internet listing opens and contains a land/plot signal. Save source HTML and expose every accepted row on the 8012 website.
acceptance: Only successfully opened real internet listing pages with land or plot evidence may be added.
Every added row must include listing_url, saved local_source_path, batch_id, evidence_updated_at, new_this_run, run_status, status_json_path and report_md_path.
Website JSON must update so accepted rows appear row-by-row after refresh.
No 3.5+ confidence, visual_match_score or VISION_COMPARED status without downloaded photos, canonical polygon render and real vision comparison.
Git push and remote branch readback must be recorded in the task output.
Do not create or request another runner.
